Cc: 
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + one quick question on fit (next step options)

Hi Simon — thanks again for taking the call earlier. Quick recap and a single ask below.

Call recap (15m):
- You’re evaluating inference for production ranking and document understanding across 3 ML teams.
- Key constraints: sub-100ms P99 for short prompts, strict VPC-only data path, and predictable month-to-month costs.
- Success metric you mentioned: reduce per-inference cost by ~40% while matching current quality.

Attachments: discovery notes + estimated cost sample attached for the use-case we sketched.

One quick question: on a scale of 1 (not a fit) to 5 (very likely fit), how would you rate Redwood for this initiative after today’s call? A one-digit answer will help me prioritize next steps with our engineering team.

If it’s helpful, next steps I can propose:
- Option A: 30-minute technical deep-dive with our runtime engineer (best if you want kernel/latency details)
- Option B: 2-week sandbox pilot (we provide a reserved test pool and a cost pass to estimate production numbers)
- Option C: Not a fit — we’ll close the loop and check back in ~3 months

Would you reply with a single digit (1–5) and pick one of the three options? If you prefer, I can send three calendar times.

Thanks — Neha
